notifications.title: 网站全新升级
notifications.content:
盒鸽 HcDove 官网已升级为 Vue 3 架构，支持后端数据动态更新，体验更流畅！

主要改进：
• Vue 3 + Vite 6 构建，加载速度大幅提升
• 后端数据模式，内容更新无需重新构建
• 通知公告系统，及时获取最新动态
• 响应式设计，完美适配移动端

感谢您一直以来的支持，我们将持续优化体验！
notifications.contentEn:
HcDove website has been upgraded to Vue 3 architecture with dynamic backend data updates for a smoother experience!

Key improvements:
• Vue 3 + Vite 6 build, significantly faster loading
• Backend data mode, content updates without rebuilding
• Notification system for latest updates
• Responsive design, perfect for mobile

Thank you for your continued support!

notifications.title: 通知公告系统上线
notifications.content:
新增通知公告功能，及时获取团队最新动态和产品更新。

功能特性：
• 导航栏铃铛图标，未读数量提示
• 点击查看通知详情
• 已读状态本地存储
• 支持中英文双语

点击铃铛即可查看所有通知！
notifications.contentEn:
New notification feature launched to keep you updated with the latest team news and product updates.

Features:
• Bell icon in navbar with unread count badge
• Click to view notification details
• Read status stored locally
• Bilingual support (CN/EN)

Click the bell to see all notifications!

notifications.title: 新游戏开发中
notifications.content:
团队正在开发一款全新的游戏，敬请期待！

更多详情将在近期公布，请持续关注我们的官方渠道。
notifications.contentEn:
Our team is developing a brand new game. Stay tuned!

More details will be announced soon. Please follow our official channels.

notifications.title: AI 工具页面更新
notifications.content:
AI 页面已支持后端数据动态更新，新增工具和智能体将自动展示。

前往 AI 页面查看最新内容！
notifications.contentEn:
The AI page now supports dynamic backend data updates. New tools and agents will be displayed automatically.

Visit the AI page to see the latest content!

notifications.title: 关于页面改版
notifications.content: 关于我们页面已全面改版，展示更清晰的团队介绍和愿景。
notifications.contentEn: The About page has been fully redesigned with a clearer team introduction and vision.

notifications.title: 系统维护通知
notifications.content:
2026年7月15日凌晨 2:00-4:00 进行系统维护，期间网站可能短暂无法访问。

给您带来的不便敬请谅解。
notifications.contentEn:
System maintenance on July 15, 2026, 2:00-4:00 AM. The website may be briefly unavailable during this period.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

notifications.title: 盒鸽 HcDove 两周年
notifications.content:
感谢大家两年来的支持与陪伴！

盒鸽 HcDove 成立于 2022 年，两年来我们不断成长，推出了多款游戏和 AI 产品。未来我们将继续努力，为大家带来更多优质内容！
notifications.contentEn:
Thank you all for your support over the past two years!

HcDove was founded in 2022. Over the past two years, we have grown continuously and launched multiple games and AI products. We will continue to work hard to bring you more quality content!
